title: Open app and file, save as, step by step
goal: A planned sequence runs with readback after each step
acceptance: One approval for the whole plan; readback each step; stops on a step outside the plan
Save as never overwrites without asking
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, screenshots of the owner's screen or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
